'''2007 Texas State Championship Joseph Graham LS Massassi Base Operations''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Joseph Graham]] at [[2007 Texas State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Massassi Base Operations / One In A Million|TA-L-massassibaseoperations.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' MBO (Mmmm, Boy...)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
